source: Existing Easy Joy official About copy, supplied by the restaurant website owner in this conversation.
sourceText: Easy Joy Dim Sum & AYCE Hot Pot is a Chinese restaurant located at 145 Mulberry St, New York, NY 10013, offering all-you-can-eat experience of authentic hot pot and handcrafted dim sum in a lively and welcoming setting. We are committed to using fresh, high-quality ingredients, including locally sourced produce and time-honored recipes, to bring guests an unforgettable and authentic taste of Chinese cuisine. Our signature dishes include Spicy Sichuan Hot Pot, Cantonese Shrimp Dumplings, and Steamed Pork Buns, each prepared with authentic flavors and meticulous culinary skill. Visit Chinese restaurant Easy Joy Hot Pot Dim Sum Buffet in New York’s Chinatown and enjoy a flavorful, authentic, and satisfying dining experience that will keep you coming back for more.
headline: Three Chinese classics,
one table on Mulberry.
intro: Easy Joy Hot Pot, Dim Sum & BBQ Skewers is a Chinese restaurant at 145 Mulberry St in New York’s Chinatown, offering all-you-can-eat hot pot, with handcrafted dim sum and BBQ skewers ordered à la carte, in a lively, welcoming setting.
homeSummary: Come together over hot pot, handcrafted dim sum and BBQ skewers in a lively, welcoming Chinatown setting.
homeDetail: Our kitchen pairs fresh, high-quality ingredients, including locally sourced produce, with time-honored recipes to bring authentic Chinese flavors to the table.

kitchenIntro: We pair fresh, high-quality ingredients, including locally sourced produce, with time-honored recipes. Every dish is prepared with care to bring out the authentic flavors of Chinese cuisine.

values.title: A dim sum cart at lunch
values.text: Before 5 PM, 4–6 dim sum rotate through the dining room on the cart and come with the $28 hot pot. The rest of the dim sum menu, and every BBQ skewer, is ordered à la carte.

values.title: Broths worth the trip
values.text: Coconut chicken, pickled radish duck, pork bone, tomato and Tom Yum, plus spicy Sichuan for heat seekers.

values.title: Skewers off the grill
values.text: Lamb, beef, chicken, squid and vegetables, grilled and brought to the table.

signatures.name: Spicy Sichuan Hot Pot
signatures.description: Our spicy Sichuan broth, built for sharing with sliced meats, vegetables and house dipping sauces.
signatures.alt: Copper hot pots with broth, sliced meats and vegetables

signatures.name: Cantonese Shrimp Dumplings
signatures.description: Translucent wrappers folded around whole shrimp, steamed to order.
signatures.alt: Shrimp dumplings in a bamboo steamer

signatures.name: Pan-Fried Pork Buns
signatures.description: Golden on the bottom and juicy inside: a dim sum classic to pass around the table.

experienceText: Whether you come for hot pot, dim sum or BBQ skewers, Easy Joy brings a flavorful and satisfying Chinese dining experience to Mulberry Street. Explore the menu, plan your visit and come enjoy a little Easy Joy.
